project_type: Monorepo: Cloudflare Workers (TypeScript edge) + FastAPI (Python backend) + Frontend
build_system: pnpm workspace (root), pip + Docker (backend), wrangler (edge). CI uses pnpm install --frozen-lockfile for node, pip install with hash-stripped requirements for Python.
test_framework: vitest for edge (apps/edge/tests/), pytest with pytest-asyncio for backend (apps/backend/tests/conftest.py fixtures)
build_command: Edge: cd apps/edge && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit; Backend: docker build -t syrabit-backend apps/backend
test_command: Edge: cd apps/edge && pnpm exec vitest run; Backend: cd apps/backend && pytest tests/ --tb=short -q
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install at root (--frozen-lockfile or regenerate), 2. pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit, 3. pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test, 4. pip install backend deps, 5. pytest apps/backend/tests/ with APP_ENV=test
setup_instructions: Root: corepack enable && pnpm install. Backend: pip install -r requirements.txt (strip hashes first). Set env: JWT_SECRET, APP_ENV=test, MONGODB_URI, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js 22, Python 3.11 pre-installed. No running MongoDB instance (tests must mock). No Cloudflare account (cannot do actual deploy).
contribution_requirements: CI uses pnpm --frozen-lockfile so lockfile must be up to date. Backend CI strips hashes from requirements.txt before install. Tests may have pre-existing failures from missing services (Razorpay, Redis, MongoDB) - these need mocking.
key_patterns: Edge: middleware pattern (jwt.ts, bot.ts, cors.ts, rate-limit.ts), routes (api-proxy.ts, isr.ts, robots.ts). Backend: FastAPI lifespan for DB init, Beanie ODM with init_beanie(), Upstash Redis HTTP client, admin auth via httponly cookie (not Bearer), Razorpay webhook signature verification with HMAC.
directory_structure: Root monorepo with pnpm-workspace.yaml pointing to apps/*. apps/edge/ = Cloudflare Worker (TS), apps/backend/ = FastAPI (Python), .github/workflows/ = CI pipelines.
